csrfToken.description: The CSRF token to use in subsequent requests

post.description: Stores the current filter, sort, and column visibility state in Redis cache. Called on filter Apply and sort column click. State expires after TABLE_STATE_CACHE_TTL seconds.

parameters.description: Slug of the table to fetch views for

post.description: Saves the current table state as a named view snapshot. The name must be unique per user+table.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: UUID of the table view to update

400.description: Validation failed or not owned by caller.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a named view. Only the owner can delete their own views.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: UUID of the table view to delete

parameters.name: id

409.description: A view with this name already exists.

patch.description: Makes a view visible to all users (shared) or restricts it to the owner only (private). Only the owner can toggle sharing.

post.description: Authenticates a nexus user with email and password. Returns an access token and sets a refresh token in an httpOnly cookie.

400.description: Invalid input data or validation error.

401.description: Invalid credentials or account not active.

post.description: Invalidates the current session and clears the refresh token cookie.
Sets a password for a nexus user who was created via webhook. Requires a SET_PASSWORD session token. Invalidates the session on success — user must log in again.

400.description: Password mismatch or password already set.

post.description: Validates a SET_PASSWORD invitation token, sets the user password, and invalidates all sessions. The user must log in again after setting their password.

400.description: Password mismatch or password already set.

get.description: Checks whether the user has an active session using the httpOnly refresh cookie. Never returns 401 — returns isAuthenticated: false instead.

post.description: Generates a new access token and rotates the refresh token using the httpOnly cookie. Sets the new refresh token in the cookie.

get.description: Recovers the session by reading the refresh token from the httpOnly cookie and returns a new access token. Does not rotate the refresh token.

post.description: Sends a 6-digit OTP to the email address if an account exists. Creates a RESET session and sets the refresh cookie. Always returns the same generic message to prevent email enumeration.
Generates a new OTP and resends the reset email. Requires an active RESET session token. Rotates the refresh cookie.
Verifies the 6-digit OTP submitted by the user. Requires an active RESET session. Marks the verification as complete, enabling the reset-password endpoint.

400.description: Invalid, expired, or too many attempts on OTP.

post.description: Sets a new password after OTP has been verified. Requires an active RESET session. Invalidates all existing sessions, creates a new NEXUS session, and rotates the refresh cookie.

400.description: OTP not verified, reset window expired, or weak password.

post.description: Returns all organizations the user belongs to. Used by the mobile app to present an organization picker before login.
Authenticates a user with email and password. Returns access token and refresh token in the response body. No cookies are used.

400.description: Invalid input data or validation error.

401.description: Invalid credentials or account not active.

post.description: Rotates both access and refresh tokens. Requires the current refresh token in the request body. Returns new tokens in the response body.
Invalidates the current session. The client should clear stored tokens.

400.description: Invalid input data or validation error.

400.description: Invalid input data or validation error.

get.description: Returns all roles for an organization with their feature counts. Protected by webhook secret.

get.summary: List roles compatible with a business unit

post.description: Creates a new role with validated features. Features must belong to the organization. Validates name uniqueness within the org.

patch.description: Updates role metadata (name, description, scope). If features are provided, replaces the features jsonb array.

delete.description: Deletes a role. Cascade delete removes associated user_role_assignments automatically.

post.description: Creates a new business unit for an organization. Computes depth and materialized path from the parent. Requires X-Webhook-Secret header.

400.description: Invalid input data or validation error.

get.description: Returns a flat list of all business units for an organization, ordered by depth and sort order. Client builds the tree from parentId.
Returns a business unit and all its descendants using materialized path prefix matching.

patch.description: Updates a business unit name, code, type, timezone, metadata, or active status.

delete.description: Deletes a business unit. Fails if the unit has child business units — they must be removed or reassigned first.

patch.description: Sets the assigned app codes for a business unit. Requires X-Webhook-Secret header.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user profile information. Profile changes must be requested through the admin.

post.description: Verifies the current password and replaces it with a new one. Rejects if the new password is identical to the current one.

400.description: Current password incorrect or new password is the same.

get.description: Returns all active sessions for the authenticated user. The current session is flagged with isCurrent: true.

delete.description: Deletes the specified session. Cannot be used to revoke the current session — use logout instead.

post.description: Deletes all sessions for the user except the current one. Pushes a logout event to all affected sessions via SSE.
